Hi community,

We’ve made a few important updates across the pages and guidelines to help you finalize your work smoothly, including:

* **Methods Template Update:** The methods description template has been updated to include a new required question regarding LLM usage. Please ensure you use the [latest template](https://huggingface.co/spaces/SageBio/rare-disease-real-kid-mva-hackathon-2026/resolve/main/static/templates/methods_description_form.xlsx?download=true) for future submissions. **If you have already submitted**, please upload the updated report to the GitHub repo linked in your submission—no need to resubmit!
* **Clarification on GitHub repositories:** We've added clear guidelines on what to include in your GitHub repositories. Your repos can also remain private for the duration of the Hackathon, but must be made public once final evaluations begin.
* **Track 2 Submission Quota Increased (1 → 3):** To accommodate any adjustments to your methods or findings, we’ve raised the Track 2 submission limit from one attempt to 3. _**Important note:** The independent expert panel will only review your LATEST submission, so please ensure your final submission is the one to be reviewed._
* **Updated FAQ**

Thank you all for your hard work and great questions so far! Feel free to reply below if anything needs clarification.

Important note: The independent expert panel will only review your LATEST submission, so please ensure your final submission is the one to be reviewed.
  • Updated FAQ

Thank you all for your hard work and great questions so far! Feel free to reply below if anything needs clarification.
